summary.text: NORHEIMSUND JERNVAREHANDEL AS is a private limited company registered in Øystese, founded 2023-10-06. Norheimsund Jernvarehandel AS buys and sells goods in the categories hardware, cars, boats, leisure, home and more. It was previously named HARDANGER TREFELLING AS until 2024-05-27. Its main industry code is 47.520: retail sale of hardware, building materials, paints and glass. The register shows 5 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 5 984 946 NOK and the annual result was -68 997 NOK; operating income was up from 4 730 579 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 896 838 NOK in 2024 to -68 997 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 1 291 268 NOK in 2024 to 1 222 272 NOK in 2025. Recent changes in the register: employees set to 5 on 2026-08-13.
